abstract: Heterotransplantation of primary and secondary human testis tumors and the established cell lines, tera-1 and tera-2, into nude mice has been performed. The cell lines have been successfully grown subcutaneously and in the anterior chamber of the eye, without further immunosuppression, and this has contributed to the characterization of the lines. Growth has not been obtained with the fresh tumor material.
abstract_ja: 原発性および転移性のヒト精巣腫瘍および確立された細胞株tera-1およびtera-2を、ヌードマウスに異種移植した。細胞株は、それ以上の免疫抑制なしに皮下および眼の前房で増殖させることに成功し、これは細胞株の特性解析に寄与した。新鮮な腫瘍材料では増殖は得られなかった。
